A typical year has 365 days.

The described data breach has a severe impact due to the sensitive nature of the compromised information. The exposure of patient names, health insurance details, medical histories, and treatment information creates significant risks for the 200,000 affected individuals. Specifically, the combination of personally identifiable information (names) and financial/insurance data facilitates identity theft and insurance fraud. Furthermore, the disclosure of detailed medical histories and treatment information violates patient privacy and could lead to discrimination or emotional distress, compounding the financial risks associated with the breach.
